textures aren't the heavy thing, high poligon counts are, an actual high end AAA title like the witcher 3 for example, main characters have around 5million polygons or so when they are developed on 3D apps like Zbrush or Mudbox, but then those are retopologized on a lower poligon count on another 3D software like Maya or 3ds Max so they can be able to be rigged and animated.

After that, all of the details on the 1st program are turned into a texture called Normal map, and they make it match on the retopologized model, and after applied, the final model fot the game looks just like the first one, high poly detalied, but with lower poly count goodness to be able to be in a lower size file load and to be able to be rigged and animated with all of the corresponding stuff it needs, like blendshapes for example: facial expressions
